user.title: Goldenergy Setup
user.description: Sign in with your Goldenergy customer area account (clientes.goldenergy.pt). Data is refreshed twice a day (02:00 and 14:00).

account.title: Choose a billing account
account.description: You have more than one billing account. Pick the one this entry should track — add the integration again for the others.

energies.title: Choose what to track
energies.description: Billing account {account} supplies: {supplies}. Choose which of them this entry should track. You can change this later in the integration's options.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Goldenergy
reauth_confirm.description: The stored password for {username} no longer works. Enter the current customer area password to continue.

error.energy_not_on_account: This billing account does not supply one of the energies you enabled

abort.already_configured: This billing account is already configured
abort.no_accounts: This customer has no billing accounts to track
abort.unknown_account: That billing account is no longer available
abort.no_energy_supplies: This billing account has no gas or electricity supply

init.title: Goldenergy options
init.description: Choose which energies to track. The gas meter counts m³ but Goldenergy bills kWh, using the network's conversion factor printed on the invoice next to the reading; set it here so the gas energy sensors and statistics match your invoice.

error.energy_not_on_account: This billing account does not supply one of the energies you enabled
